Legally speaking, the jumpers are homicide victims, but that doesn't mean they can't be considered suicides as well, and saying that isn't victim blaming or letting al-Qaeda off the hook. They would've died either way, but suicide is defined as deliberately causing one's own death, and USA Today even said they "made a conscious choice to die by falling rather than the [...] fire."
